titel: The New Room: Dov'è il gatto?
grammatik: Prepositions of place (in, sopra, sotto, accanto a, davanti a)

grammatik.regel: Where? → *essere* + preposition + place: *sopra* il tavolo, *sotto* il tavolo, *accanto alla* lampada, *davanti al* tavolo, *nella* libreria. Don't forget *il* / *la*! *a + il* becomes *al*: davanti *al* divano, but davanti *alla* lampada. *in + la* becomes *nella*. Use *essere* (*è*, *sono*) for where things are: *Dov'è il gatto? Dove sono le chiavi?*

redemittel.p2: Nella mia foto il gatto _è_ *sopra* il divano.

redemittel.p1: Nella mia no! Nella mia _è_ *sotto* il tavolo.

redemittel.p2: Il libro _è_ *nella* libreria. E nella tua?

soGehts: Giulia has a new room. Partner A has a photo from Monday, Partner B has a photo from Tuesday.
Cut pages 2 and 3 in the middle. Don't show your picture!
Alone: look at your picture. Put the tiles in order and write four sentences. The words *il* / *la* are missing on the cards: write them yourself.
Together: describe your picture and ask questions. Find six differences and write them down.
At the end: put the pictures next to each other and check.
